The last supper, Matthew 26. Jesus took bread and the cup, giving thanks, teaching His friends what His body and blood would mean, and a new testament in my blood, shed for many for the remission of sins. The cross was coming, the cup was not taken away, and still He said, I will not drink, until the Father's kingdom. The Lord's table is not about snacks—it is about His suffering love and our remembering Him until He comes.
